mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, published_at, last_error, create_time, modify_time FROM pms_outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status = 'PENDING'
